description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeModel class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the PIM (Personnel Information Management) plugin. The class wraps an Employee entity and prepares it for serialization/deserialization, including setting filters and attribute names for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeModel
classes.description: Represents a serializable model of the Employee entity, providing specific filters and attribute mappings for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeModel with an Employee entity, and sets filters and attribute names for serialization.
